root.command: IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PeopleTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.PeopleTbl', N'IsDispatched') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.PeopleTbl ADD IsDispatched BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_People_IsDispatched DEFAULT (0); END

-- Seed classic Prgo / Cour by abbreviation (and known IDs as backup). IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PeopleTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.PeopleTbl', N'IsDispatched') IS NOT NULL BEGIN UPDATE dbo.PeopleTbl SET IsDispatched = 1 WHERE IsDispatched = 0 AND ( UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Abbreviation))) IN (N'PRGO', N'COUR') OR PersonID IN (5, 7) ); END
SELECT PersonID, Abbreviation, Person, IsDispatched, Enabled FROM dbo.PeopleTbl WHERE IsDispatched = 1 ORDER BY Abbreviation;
